output.summary: Turnover rise is real: HR counts reconcile to payroll, so the reporting-artifact claim is contradicted. Peers rose only 33% to 38%, so the market explains part of the rise but not the whole. Separations stepped up in March 2026, when the Saturday policy took effect at all branches, before ShiftWise went live on 2026-04-13. Pay was the top exit reason in both years, so it doesn't explain the change. Schedule complaints rose from 19% to 48%. No pay benchmark exists. There is no branch-level data, and the manager-of-record field is stale, so a bonus penalty built on it would be harmful. The evidence is insufficient for a pay increase or manager sanctions. Next steps are the branch and rollout comparison and the pay benchmark.
